# Apples from the small tree again

The bruised apples make excellent sauce again. Last September's note prevented an unnecessary replacement order. [[Garden notebook]] now has two seasons of the same practical choice, not proof of a universal rule about imperfect fruit. Keep the photograph and recipe together so the next harvest has somewhere to go.
